# Peeref

> > Peeref is a platform for academic researchers offering journal discovery tools, peer review insights, and a community-driven knowledge base covering research workflows, graduate education, and scientific communication.

Peeref serves the global research community with practical tools for manuscript submission and journal selection across 38,000+ academic outlets. The platform features expert perspectives on reproducibility, open science practices, academic career development, and peer review processes from contributors including Ariel Zhang, Martin Shaw, and researchers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- peer-review
- journal-selection
- manuscript-submission
- academic-publishing
- reproducibility
- graduate-school
- higher-education
- open-science

- scientific-writing
- academic-career-development

- conservation-biology
- research-transparency

## Core Tools & Features

- [Discover the best journals for your manuscript submission](https://www.peeref.com/journals): Journal discovery tool with 38,000+ outlets filtered by metrics & reviews
- [The 5-min Research Presentation Challenge 2024](https://www.peeref.com/webinar-competition): Global research presentation competition with peer voting and prizes

## Academic Writing & Peer Review

- [What Reviewers See in the Methods Section](https://www.peeref.com/notes/21c17576-752a-44c9-968d-0dc41f0fc7c6): Scientific writing guide for reproducible methods in peer review
- [Transparency starts in your notebook](https://www.peeref.com/notes/4c8d67a0-3abe-4eb2-b8db-a279c199c57b): Open science practices and lab notebook documentation workflows
- [Planning with Intentionality](https://www.peeref.com/notes/80fd345f-b052-4197-ba50-2021d905b4ad): Experimental planning methodology for reproducible lab research
- [NSF is relaxing some of its requirements for the review of grant proposals](https://www.peeref.com/notes/f0741bbb-f9f2-406e-bed6-8bbc80d34cf3): NSF grant proposal peer review policy changes and funding updates

## Graduate School & Academic Career

- [There will be days you want to quit](https://www.peeref.com/notes/a07c315a-9ea4-407b-8794-1744d6179682): PhD student mental health and perseverance in graduate school
- [Learning to Navigate Advisor Relationships](https://www.peeref.com/notes/117bc703-844a-42cc-ab3b-fcc8c42bb6a6): Graduate student mentorship communication and advisor dynamics guide
- [Navigating a Career Transition in Academia](https://www.peeref.com/notes/6cd6c21b-07ba-43f8-985d-53ee875c73fb): Martin Shaw on academic career transitions and professional development
- [What Change Feels Like Inside Universities](https://www.peeref.com/notes/3a48ad8a-6a1b-48e9-ae3a-cd011a218b11): Martin Shaw on organizational change and leadership in higher education
- [Rethinking Computer Science Education in the Age of AI](https://www.peeref.com/notes/e800a53a-1a36-4e45-b6c1-e268bcdfb369): CS curriculum reform for ChatGPT/Claude era by Gordon Marek

## Research Insights & Domain Knowledge

- [When population structure becomes a risk factor for survival](https://www.peeref.com/notes/f152ac4a-a63d-4c4f-a6b9-3472e540e9bc): Hermann's tortoise conservation study on sex ratio bias at Lake Prespa
- [Innovations in Sustainable Energy and Nanotechnology](https://www.peeref.com/notes/438301c4-4b02-471d-8024-8499d3ec71c2): Tesfaye Barza Zema on zero-emission HVAC and green materials research
- [Rainwater Harvesting for Managed Aquifer Recharge](https://www.peeref.com/notes/e5076608-c9b6-4ca7-9dc9-dc596f2b4324): South Punjab groundwater storage and flood management via recharge wells
- [The benefits of mushrooms that no one talks about!](https://www.peeref.com/notes/dfbeb0d0-edfc-4ec9-a9d5-20b44c54a474): Research review on mushroom bioactive compounds and nutritional value
- [COVID or just a common cold?](https://www.peeref.com/notes/d1a30357-46e1-4ad3-9c11-640ce8ef1d11): COVID vs common cold symptom differentiation and variant guidance
